  data_file: "../data/processed/report_data.csv"

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(rio)
  library(yaml)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
})

source(file.path("..", "R", "drugs.R"))
source(file.path("..", "R", "report_helpers.R"))

# flextable needs a pandoc it can see before it will emit Word tables.
if (!isTRUE(ensure_pandoc())) {
  stop("pandoc (>= 2) not found, so the drug tables cannot be rendered. ",
       "Run from RStudio, or put Quarto's pandoc on RSTUDIO_PANDOC.",
       call. = FALSE)
}

cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(params$config_file)

record <- import(params$data_file) %>%
  filter(sequence_name == params$sequence_name)

if (nrow(record) == 0) {
  stop("no record for sequence_name '", params$sequence_name, "' in ",
       params$data_file, call. = FALSE)
}
if (nrow(record) > 1) {
  warning("several rows for '", params$sequence_name,
          "'; reporting the first", call. = FALSE)
}
record <- record[1, ]
```

### LABORATORY INFORMATION

```{r}
#| output: asis
lab <- cfg$laboratory
field_lines(
  "Name of the testing laboratory" = lab$name,
  "Contact name"                   = lab$contact_name,
  "Telephone"                      = lab$phone,
  "Email"                          = lab$email
)
```

# HIVDR LABORATORY REPORT

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Report the coordinates actually achieved for this sample, falling back to
# the configured assay design only where the export gives no coordinates.
regions <- vapply(c("PR", "RT", "IN"), function(g) {
  start <- record[[paste0(tolower(g), "_start")]]
  end   <- record[[paste0(tolower(g), "_end")]]
  if (is.null(start) || is.null(end) ||
      is.na(start) || is.na(end)) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%s: %s-%s", g, start, end)
}, character(1))
regions <- paste(regions[!is.na(regions)], collapse = "; ")
if (!nzchar(regions)) {
  regions <- paste(sprintf("%s: %s", names(cfg$sequence_regions),
                           unlist(cfg$sequence_regions)), collapse = "; ")
}
field_lines(
  "Test ordered"        = "HIV DRUG RESISTANCE GENOTYPING",
  "Sequence includes"   = regions,
  # Prefer a subtype supplied in metadata (sierra-local does not call
  # subtypes); fall back to the Stanford export's value.
  "HIV-1 subtype"       = if (nzchar(blank_if_na(record$subtype))) {
                            record$subtype
                          } else {
                            fmt_mutations(record$subtype_percent)
                          },
  "Pre-GART viral load" = fmt_viral_load(record$pre_gart_vl),
  "Algorithm"           = sprintf("%s v%s (%s)", record$algorithm_name,
                                  record$algorithm_version,
                                  fmt_date(record$algorithm_date))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: drug-classes
#| output: asis

# Report only the classes whose gene this assay actually covered. A class
# whose gene was never sequenced is omitted entirely and listed under
# "Not tested" below -- printing it with blank results would read as though
# the drugs had been tested and found susceptible.
batch_classes <- detect_reportable_classes(record)

# Two independent tests, so a class is reported only if both agree it was
# sequenced. In a mixed batch the CSV carries columns for every gene any
# specimen covered, so this sample's own columns may be present but empty.
covered <- genes_for_record(record$genes)
reportable <- Filter(function(cls) {
  by_gene <- length(covered) == 0 || CLASS_GENE[[cls]] %in% covered
  levels_present <- DRUGS$level_col[DRUGS$class == cls]
  has_values <- any(vapply(levels_present, function(col) {
    nzchar(blank_if_na(record[[col]]))
  }, logical(1)))
  by_gene && has_values
}, batch_classes)

for (cls in reportable) {
  cat("\n###", DRUG_CLASSES[[cls]], "\n\n")

  tbl <- drug_table(record, cls, cfg)
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(drug_flextable(tbl))
  cat("\n")

  for (lbl in names(CLASS_MUTATIONS[[cls]])) {
    col <- CLASS_MUTATIONS[[cls]][[lbl]]
    cat(sprintf("**%s:** %s\n\n", lbl, fmt_mutations(record[[col]])))
  }
}

# State the assay's limits on the face of the report, so an absent class is
# never mistaken for a susceptible result.
not_tested <- setdiff(names(DRUG_CLASSES), reportable)
if (length(not_tested)) {
  cat("\n### NOT TESTED\n\n")
  cat("The following drug class(es) were **not** assessed because the",
      "corresponding gene was not sequenced in this assay. No inference",
      "about susceptibility to these drugs can be drawn from this report.\n\n")
  for (cls in not_tested) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s (%s gene not sequenced)\n",
                DRUG_CLASSES[[cls]], CLASS_GENE[[cls]]))
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```
